text: Article 43 self-assessment — the internal-control route, with evidence | CSOAI Home Products ProvBench Docs FAQ Article 43 — internal control, done with evidence EU AI Act Article 43 allows most Annex III systems to use the internal-control conformity assessment procedure — self-assessment. The law permits the route; what has been missing is credible self-assessment evidence. What credible self-assessment looks like Frozen harness — the tests are published before the run, so the run cannot be tuned to pass. Deterministic execution — pinned seeds, published splits, confidence intervals on every figure. Signed artefacts — Ed25519-signed result records a third party can verify without trusting us. Corpus-watch — when the provision text changes, the affected measurements re-fire. Self-assessment that goes stale is not assessment. What we publish for this route AI Act frozen-split harness — closed-book statutory citation measurement ProvBench — Article 50 provenance survival Free Article 50 signed passport — the entry wedge Boundary Notified bodies remain legally required for some conformity routes, and nothing here is legal advice. We make the evidence layer cheaper and verifiable; auditors and counsel stay auditors and counsel. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.
